title: Quantum-Symmetric Classes of Artin–Schelter Regular Algebras
exact_target: Classify every algebra quantum-symmetrically equivalent to a given Artin--Schelter regular algebra.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005659 (OWR-14297741-012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Tensor-Triangular Geometry and Interactions (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/40, pp. 2303--2358. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: This asks for the full equivalence class in the report's specified relation, not merely a list of ordinary algebra isomorphisms.
